capacity_usable_kwh.notes: BMW US release: usable energy "up to" a maximum of 112.5 kWh (net); the page does not split 50 xDrive and 60 xDrive, so it may not apply to the 50 xDrive.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: BMW Gen6 cylindrical cells reduce cobalt and raise nickel (BMWBLOG); the i3 50 xDrive Gen6 cell is listed as NCM (evspecifications). The i7 page names only "sixth-generation cylindrical cells".

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: no i7 page states voltage. BMW US page: 250 kW (reportedly at up to 630 A, about 400 V; 800 V would give about 500 kW) and no 800 V mention, while BMW states 800 V for Neue Klasse models. Not confirmed.

preconditioning.notes: BMW US i7 page: battery preparation preconditions the pack before DC charging, starts automatically when navigating to a DC station and can be started manually from the Central Display or My BMW app.

dc_max_kw.notes: BMW US release: peak rises from 195 to 250 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: AC not stated for 2027; 2023-2026 US i7 is 11 kW (InsideEVs). A charger change with the facelift is not excluded.

published_10_80_min.notes: BMW US release: 10-80 % in "just 28 minutes at certain fast charging stations".
